transport.build_dependencies: Backend wheels were downloaded through supported curl commands with a 2 MiB per-file limit, then verified against recorded PyPI SHA-256 metadata. Isolated PEP517 builds use only those local wheels.
transport.git_dependencies: Five task-local bare mirrors from canonical checkouts plus a depth-2 SDK mirror cloned directly from GitHub. Original declared Git URLs resolve through task-local insteadOf settings.
transport.remote_availability: All six exact dependency commits independently read successfully through the GitHub commits API before the run. Installed Git commit IDs match the composition pins.
transport.limits: Mirror-backed offline dependency resolution and installed interfaces; unrestricted online uv resolution and live provider/service execution are not tested.

limitations: Exact-match verifier only; other verification adapters planned.
Architectures/artifacts are specifications, not implemented engines.
CPU authored fixtures and mocked SDK transport; no live service, GPU, paid job or scientific proof.
Mirror-backed offline installation, not unrestricted online resolver proof.
